Following the label, create an `<input>` with `type="checkbox"` and `id="show-button-text-checkbox"`.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the rendered HTML, when queried, then a checkbox with id `show-button-text-checkbox` must exist.
Given the rendered HTML, when queried, then a label with the `for` attribute `show-button-text-checkbox` must exist.

changeDirectives.humanReadableDescription: Update options.js to manage the state of the new checkbox.

logic: Import `SHOW_BUTTON_TEXT_KEY` from constants.
In `save_options`, get the `checked` status of `#show-button-text-checkbox` and save it to `chrome.storage.sync` with the key `SHOW_BUTTON_TEXT_KEY`.
In `restore_options`, retrieve the item for `SHOW_BUTTON_TEXT_KEY` from `chrome.storage.sync`.
In `restore_options`, set the `checked` property of `#show-button-text-checkbox` to the retrieved value.
Ensure a 'change' event listener on `#show-button-text-checkbox` calls `save_options`.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the user checks the box, when `save_options` is triggered, then `chrome.storage.sync.set` must be called with an object containing `{ showButtonText: true }`.
Given `chrome.storage.sync` contains `{ showButtonText: false }`, when `restore_options` is called, then the `#show-button-text-checkbox` element's `checked` property must be `false`.

logic: Add a new CSS rule: `.gcal-filter-bar.show-icon-only .gcal-text-label { display: none; }`
acceptanceCriteria: Given an element with class `gcal-text-label` inside a parent with classes `gcal-filter-bar` and `show-icon-only`, then the element must not be displayed.

inputs.name: showText
inputs.description: If true, text is shown. If false, text is hidden.

logic: Select the element with class `.gcal-filter-bar`.
Call `classList.toggle('show-icon-only', !showText)` on the element.
acceptanceCriteria: Given `showText` is `false`, when the function is called, then the `.gcal-filter-bar` element must have the `show-icon-only` class.
Given `showText` is `true`, when the function is called, then the `.gcal-filter-bar` element must not have the `show-icon-only` class.

logic: Import `updateButtonTextView` from `./modules/toolbar.js`.
Import `SHOW_BUTTON_TEXT_KEY` from `./modules/constants.js`.
On initial load, get `SHOW_BUTTON_TEXT_KEY` from `chrome.storage.sync` and call `updateButtonTextView` with the result.
Create a `chrome.storage.onChanged` listener.
Inside the listener, check if `changes[SHOW_BUTTON_TEXT_KEY]` exists.
If it exists, call `updateButtonTextView` with `changes[SHOW_BUTTON_TEXT_KEY].newValue`.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the setting `showButtonText` is changed in storage, when the `onChanged` event fires, then `updateButtonTextView` must be called with the new value.

acceptanceCriteria: Given the 'Show text' checkbox is unchecked by a user event, when `save_options` is called, then `chrome.storage.sync.set` must be called with an object containing `{ showButtonText: false }`.
